checklist.note: Instructional prose for the agent's own task; no directive that overrides or hijacks the session.
Nothing leaves the machine; the skill reads and writes project files only.
No key, token or credential in SKILL.md or the config templates.
The documented commands are npm i -D of named dev dependencies, npm run check, and the pre-push hook running it; nothing destructive or irreversible.
Plain config files and Markdown; no encoded payloads.
npm i -D installs named packages through the project's package manager with the registry it already trusts; no URL and no download-and-run script.
No reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, a keychain or a cookie store.
No sudo or setuid; the pre-push hook is a project git hook wired by npm run prepare, visible in the repo, not a system-level persistence.

trigger.method: trigger-runner.mjs: the description is copied verbatim into a probe skill in a fresh project, and each query runs as a nested `claude -p` with no user settings, plugins, hooks or MCP. A run counts as TRIGGERED only when the Skill tool fires for that probe. best_score and accuracy are over (case, rep) rows.
